title: Training Sheet: Income-Loss Addition to the Extra-Guest Share (Roamhaven Listings)
content:
# Training Sheet — Income-Loss Addition

*Host Support training, Roamhaven Listings.*

## The rule

On top of the standard extra-guest share, a listing may carry an income-loss addition, worked out on the day of the extra-guest fee reset. It reads how many cancelled nights the HostCover level that the listing's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan holds pays for lost income on one income-loss claim:

| Cancelled nights paid for lost income by the HostCover level on the listing's active plan | Added to the listing's extra-guest share |
|---|---|
| none (the level pays no cancelled nights; its figure is 0) | 0.06 |
| at least 1 and at most 14 nights | 0.03 |
| more than 14 nights | nothing |

## Questions and answers

**The level pays exactly 14 cancelled nights.**
That is "at most 14": 0.03.

**The level pays 15 cancelled nights.**
More than 14: nothing is added.

**The level pays 1 cancelled night.**
At least 1 and at most 14: 0.03.

**Which plan is read?**
The listing's active HostCover plan, through the level it holds.
